Three.js 0.180.0 · MIT license (see LICENSE).

Pinned, locally served browser ES modules downloaded from the official npm package via jsDelivr:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.min.js

No runtime CDN request is made. Textures and sign labels are generated locally; no student data is sent by the renderer.
